notes: Mathlib already has ZMod.isCyclic_units_of_prime_pow, IsCyclic.card_pow_eq_one_le and the instance isCyclic_units_two_pow_quotient_neg_one (cyclic quotient by <-1>), found with three greps of UnitsCyclic.lean and Cyclic/Subgroup.lean. Odd p and odd-ell cases were short (order divides phi(2^e) which divides 2^e, coprime to ell). The hard part was ell=2 on 2^e: I proved a general lemma that a finite comm group with a subgroup N of card <=2 and cyclic quotient has <=4 solutions of u^2=1, via Finset.card_le_mul_card_image and fibres injecting into N. Added helper lemmas torsion_card_cyclic_le and torsion_card_sq_le_four; the three target statements are unchanged (order of the third and second swapped in file, since the second uses the third).
